column4: Formats a dot-prefixed temp file name with a random suffix; the exclusive create in create_scratch, not the name, is what prevents collisions.
Thin wrapper over File::sync_all for durability; decides nothing.
Generic write-sync-rename-syncdir sequence returning where it stopped; the content and who may write it are decided by callers, and it only reports failures.
Durably writes already-sealed record bytes and cleans up on failure; sealing and the decision to commit are made upstream.
Test-only fault hook followed by a delegation to write_manifest; adds no decision of its own.
Passes None provenance to stage_publication and maps the refusal to AccountError; the refresh CAS check is in refresh_tokens.
Maps a ManifestRefusal variant to an AccountError category; pure error conversion.
Whitespace-splits, sorts and dedups a scope string into the shape validate_record accepts; a pure transform.
Maps an absent optional string to empty for the revision digest input; a plain conversion.
Returns an operator-facing sentence chosen by sole_operator_asserted, which makes the actual decision; this only formats text.
Resolves the default 3.x token location and forwards to migrate_from, where binding and refusal decisions are made.
Wraps a token string's bytes; inert constructor.
Plain getter returning the wrapped bytes as str; no decision.
Maps ProviderOutcome variants to fixed wire strings; formatting only.
Forwards to CustodyHandle::invalidate; the revoke itself is decided in PersonalAccountStore::revoke_capturing.
Arc blanket impl forwarding to T::refresh; no decision.
Inert constructor storing store, provider, observer and an empty flights map.
Plain getter for the store reference.
Plain getter for the refresh provider reference.
Plain getter of the in-flight bound; the bound is enforced in admit.
Clones the account key and delegates to AccountService::resolve through offload; admission is in admit and the lookup decision is in the service.
Clones the lease and delegates to AccountService::release through offload; the decision lives in the service and in admit.
Clones the account key and delegates to AccountService::invalidate through offload; the decision lives in the service and in admit.
Looks up the account name of an active journey by id for the pre-session dead-link check; ownership and authentication are decided later in start.
